title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, & the Company's tariff M.D.P.U. 524, for Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of March, April and May 1989. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 CMR 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 477. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8;.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory policies Act of 1978.
